notes: TEMPORARY OVERLAY of the official Paperclip image. `upstream` is the pinned official image the extended Dockerfile FROMs (pinned by DIGEST because upstream publishes only :latest + sha- tags). The overlay applies one patch to the openclaw-gateway adapter: negotiate gateway protocol v4 (upstream hard-codes v3) and drop the `paperclip` agentParams field that OpenClaw's v4 gateway rejects (strict schema). Without it, Paperclip agents cannot connect to our v4 OpenClaw containers. Upstream tracks this but has not shipped a fix. `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev/prod; the `bootstrap` placeholder falls back to `upstream` (unpatched) so an env keeps deploying before the extended image exists. TO REVERT to the official image once upstream fixes it: see apps/infra/paperclip-extended/README.md.
